providers.title: Providers
providers.description: OpenRouter and VSEGPT keys are saved separately in secure storage. A prefix identifies the service; it does not confirm authorization or available funds.
providers.default_help: This choice applies only to new chats. Existing chats keep their provider.
providers.enter_key: Enter a key to identify its service.
providers.unknown_prefix: Unknown or incomplete prefix. The key has not been sent anywhere.
providers.detected: Detected {provider}. Authorization is not yet confirmed.
providers.mismatch: This is a {detected} key, while {selected} is selected. Use the matching provider field.
providers.saved_key: A key is saved; its value is never loaded into this field.
providers.operation_failed: The operation could not finish. The saved key was not replaced; try again.
providers.checked: Authorization confirmed by a free check.
providers.check_failed: Authorization was not confirmed. The saved key is unchanged.
providers.unverified_help: Authorization is unconfirmed. You may explicitly save the recognized key as unverified; the first request is sent only when you send a chat message.
providers.status.network_error: Check unavailable due to a network error
providers.balance_status.unavailable: An unknown amount does not mean a zero balance.
providers.balance_status.stale: Showing the last known balance; refresh failed.
providers.balance_status.restricted: Balance access is restricted. OpenRouter may require management permissions; enable balance access in VSEGPT account settings.
providers.balance_status.network_error: Could not refresh balance: network error.
providers.balance_status.subscription_re: The service reports that a required subscription is missing.
providers.balance_status.warning: The service warns of a low balance; this is not a key error.
analytics.scope: For saved chats on this device. Activity in other clients is excluded. Deleting a chat also removes its statistics.
analytics.load_failed: Could not read local statistics. Try again.
analytics.token_sources: API-reported token fields, local estimates and unknown values are separate. API fields are not an independent tokenizer check. Known tokens count even when cost is unknown; partial totals are incomplete.
analytics.undated: Without a reliable date: {count}. These records are available only in all time and do not belong to a specific day.
analytics.empty: No saved requests in the selected period.
analytics.no_confirmed_tokens: No API-reported token data. Estimates and missing data are shown in the table.
analytics.estimated_tokens: Local estimate: input {input}, output {output}, total {total}. Excluded from API-reported totals.
analytics.timezone: Daily grouping: {timezone}. Dispatch times are stored in UTC.
analytics.spending_sources: USD and RUB are separate, without conversion. Confirmed spending and estimates remain separate. A request with unknown cost marks incompleteness, even when the known total is zero.
analytics.unknown_costs: Cost is unknown for {count} requests. The confirmed total is incomplete.
analytics.undated_spending: Undated: {count} requests; confirmed {actual}; estimated {estimated}. Excluded from the daily chart and average.
analytics.chart_accessible: Daily chart in {currency}: teal is confirmed spending, yellow is estimated. Values are available in the table below.
workspace.pricing_unknown: Pricing and its billing unit are unconfirmed. A cost estimate is unavailable. This is not a free model.
workspace.money_help: A local budget in {currency} does not guarantee the server balance. Unknown pricing requires separate confirmation.
workspace.paid_warning: Requests to {provider} may spend your {currency} balance.
workspace.unknown_price_warning: Cost is unknown: the estimate, remaining budget after the request and compliance with the budget cannot be guaranteed. Allow this request once, edit the limit or cancel.
workspace.key_available_notice: Available key limit {amount}. This is not the account balance.
workspace.mode_paid_help: Requests may spend the selected provider balance. Confirm the model and local chat budget before sending.
